name: piyola-v2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2: model_config.yaml pos_emb_max_len 5000, att_context_size [-1,-1] (full attention, no chunking). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Cache-aware FastConformer encoder, 24 layers, d_model 1024, 8 heads of 128, rel_pos attention, dw_striding subsampling x8, TDT decoder with durations [0,1,2,3,4]
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A finetune of nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.6 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-4.0, repo created 2026-07-23. CAVEAT: the repo id is idrock/piyola-v2 but the card, the model-index name and the only weights file (parakeet-tdt-uz-finetune.nemo) all call it parakeet-tdt-uz-finetune - the same artifact under a renamed repo. The base-comparison table is on 'the same evaluation set, same decoding' without naming that set; its per-benchmark table gives FeruzaSpeech 6.08 / FLEURS uz 10.67 / uzbek-speech-corpus 11.86 / Omnilingual 25.57 WER.

benchmarks.name: Uzbek ASR test WER %
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Comparison against the base model': row 'idrock/parakeet-tdt-uz-finetune' 12.89 vs row 'nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 (base, zero-shot)' 105.37, same Test WER column. Greedy batched TDT decoding, no LM, no rescoring. Card does not name the eval set behind this comparison table; its per-benchmark table gives 6.08 FeruzaSpeech, 10.67 FLEURS, 11.86 uzbek-speech-corpus, 25.57 Omnilingual.

benchmarks.name: Uzbek ASR test CER %
benchmarks.config: Same card table, Test CER column: this model 3.80 vs base 64.67. Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS uz test WER %
benchmarks.config: Card 'Across benchmarks' table, row 'FLEURS (uz, test)' 10.67, CER 2.78, 658 utterances, greedy TDT, no LM. Own-only; base column absent on this table.
